description: This file is a shell script used for testing various core Git commands and behaviors in a repository, including index updates, file status, object writing, checkout, read-tree operations, alias expansion, GIT_PREFIX usage, ambiguity checks, and symlink detections.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the commands within, and checks for the expected outcome.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after tests.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes lines to files for test setup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality as part of test validation.
